summary: @or-sdk/hitl preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes large obfuscated bundle on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers) and downloads the Bun standalone runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array (WV8StW) and a custom-alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9), automatically executed at install time via the freshly downloaded alternate runtime. The advertised purpose of the package is a HITL REST API client, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a large obfuscated companion payload. The delivery mechanism — pulling in an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated payload that Node-based tooling and reviewers cannot easily inspect — runs attacker-chosen code on the installer host at `npm install` time without user consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
